samples.question: The six board cells are A-F in row-major order (A-C on top, D-F below). Five pip-labeled tiles and one empty cell start as shown; the red outline marks the tile to track. Read the eight cards from left to right. On each card, the named tile slides into the empty cell only if it shares a side with the empty cell; otherwise nothing moves. Which cell contains the marked tile after all cards? Answer A, B, C, D, E, or F.
